lines.text: The LORD will lead her to the wilderness and give back her vineyards.
There she will respond as in her youth, as when she came up out of Babylon.
She will call the LORD 'my Husband,' and He will remove the names of the Baals from her lips.
The LORD will make a covenant with the beasts, birds and crawling creatures, and abolish bow and sword and battle.
The grain, new wine and oil will respond to Bethel, and He will sow her as His own.
